text.message: This function takes 4 or more inputs; the limit is 3. Work one out inside it, or pass an options object.

lessons.message: A polled load in cx.spawn can finish after a newer action and put old data back: drop results older than the last action (the `tracker` in mods/blocked-run/main.js), and never write a whole file back from a snapshot.
A new mod or a change people will notice needs its README table row and section to say what it does now, keys included (missed for system-usage, wrong for agent-board).

A pop-up's list must scroll, not clip: root size_full(), list .id(...).flex_1().min_h(0).overflow_y_scrollbar(), and no fixed overlay height the content can outgrow (as mods/agent-board/search.js does).

Before relying on how Herdr behaves (what layout() returns, how a popup sizes, which mod copy gets a command), find it in AGENTS.md, herdr.d.ts or a shipped mod doing the same; if none says so, tell the user it is a guess (a layout() guess and a popup-size guess each broke a release).

When you change code, reread the comments near it and fix or drop any that no longer hold, and keep comments under 5% of the file's lines (a stale open.js comment and an over-budget projects.js both reached review).

Before git init, worktree add or another create, check the real target in the same step (the path is empty, the branch on local and origin), not a list gathered earlier for something else (project-search trusted find's repo list and ran git init over full folders; worktree-dev checks only local branches).
